<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Excellent! Alison has booked the meeting for Thursday at 10:00 AM. This is our last session, so I need to act fast and send the confirmation email.

My plan is simple:
1.  Use the `send_confirmation_email` function.
2.  Set the `day` to "Thu" and `start` to "10:00".
3.  Write a clear and concise email body. I should mention the details of the meeting and also gently note the conflict for Elena, as I proposed in my last message.

Here's the email body I will write:

"Dear Partners,

This email confirms that your 30-minute meeting has been scheduled for **Thursday, November 19th, at 10:00 AM Eastern**.

Elena, we understand you have a conflict at this time with a "Hiring panel". We hope it will be possible for you to reschedule this. This was the only time that worked for the other three partners.

Best regards,

Brad and Alison
Scheduling Assistants"

This seems appropriate. It confirms the meeting, informs everyone of the time, and politely handles the conflict with Elena. I will now use the function to send this email. This will complete our task. I'm glad we managed to find a solution.
